newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq lower, some stocks hit by preannouncements.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq lower, some stocks hit by preannouncements.

text.p: Earnings-related drops in Atmel Corp, Sunglass Hut International Inc and Mariner Health Group Inc kept the lid on Nasdaq on Thursday, leading to its third consecutive lower close.

The Nasdaq Composite Index, struggling to bounce after two consecutive days on the downside, closed down 1.01 points, or 0.08 percent, at 1236.97 while declines led advancing issues by 2066 to 1993 on volume of about 587 million shares.

Atmel, the most actively traded Nasdaq issue was down four to 30-1/8 after saying earnings and revenues would be flat in the fourth quarter because of a low book-to-bill ratio and increased competition.
Sunglass Hut fell 4-5/16 to 9-3/16 after saying that third quarter earnings per share to fall below 1995's $0.05 per share unless sales materially exceed its budget for October.
Mariner Health was down 5-15/16 at 7-3/8. The company said it would take a one-time charge of $10 million in the third quarter to increase reserves covering changes in Medicare reimbursements.
